xai.title: Batch explainability analysis
xai.shapBarDesc: Displays the global importance of each feature across all patients. Longer bars indicate features that had the most significant impact on the model's overall predictions.
xai.shapBeeswarmDesc1: Visualizes how feature values across all patients influence the model's output. Each dot represents a single patient; its horizontal position indicates whether it increases (right) or decreases (left) the prediction risk. Color represents the feature value:

charts.shapWaterfallDesc: Visualizes how individual factors shift the prediction from the baseline. Red bars indicate factors increasing risk, while blue bars indicate factors decreasing risk.
charts.shapBarDesc: Ranks health indicators by their absolute impact on the prediction. Longer bars indicate features that contributed most strongly to the model's decision for this patient.

analyzeDashboard.title: Detailed Dataset Analysis

summary.title: Dataset summary
summary.integrityScan: * Data integrity scan identified inconsistencies. Automated cleanup applied where possible.
summary.perfectIntegrityDesc: No missing values or duplicates were detected in the dataset.

comparison.title: Dataset comparison
comparison.aboutOriginalDesc: This is your raw, untouched dataset exactly as it was uploaded. It serves as the baseline to verify the integrity of the automated preprocessing steps.
comparison.rawFormatDesc: Features retain their original scales, string text, and categorical labels.
comparison.potentialIssuesDesc: May contain duplicate rows, missing values (NaN/Null), or unencoded variables.
comparison.readinessDesc: Not yet optimized for training machine learning models.
comparison.aboutProcessedDesc: The dataset has been automatically cleaned and standardized through our pipeline to ensure optimal model performance:
comparison.cleaningDesc: Dropped rows with missing target values and removed exact duplicates to prevent bias.
comparison.encodingDesc: Applied Label Encoding to convert categorical strings into machine-readable numbers.
comparison.scalingDesc: Used Standard Scaler on numerical features to ensure equal contribution across variables (Mean=0, Variance=1).

knn.label: KNN Imputer
knn.detail: Estimates missing values using nearest neighbors in feature space.

mice.label: MICE Imputer
mice.detail: Iteratively imputes each feature using the others as predictors.

mean.label: Mean / Mode
mean.detail: Uses mean for numerical features and mode for categorical features.

default.label: Median / Mode
default.detail: Uses median for numerical features and mode for categorical features.

target_distribution.title: Target distribution
target_distribution.desc: Illustrates the distribution of the target variable. This helps identify if the dataset is balanced or imbalanced, which is crucial for model evaluation.

target_correlation.title: Target correlation
target_correlation.desc: Shows how strongly each individual numerical feature correlates directly with the target variable, highlighting the most predictive factors.

full_correlation.title: Feature correlation matrix
full_correlation.desc: Displays the correlation matrix across all features. Distinct colored regions indicate strong relationships, useful for spotting multicollinearity.

anova_score.title: ANOVA F-Test (Numerical)
anova_score.desc: Measures the linear dependency between numerical features and the target. Features with higher F-scores are highly informative for the model.

chi_square_score.title: Chi-Square (Categorical)
chi_square_score.desc: Evaluates the statistical significance of categorical features against the target variable. Higher scores indicate stronger relevance.

loadingMessages: Finalizing the most impactful feature set...
featureSelectionTab.title: Feature selection results (Genetic algorithm)
featureSelectionTab.subtitle: The algorithm has identified the most predictive subset of features. This helps in reducing dimensionality, preventing overfitting, and improving model training efficiency.

stats.noBalancingDesc: Dataset used as-is. No balancing applied.

lime.title: Local explanations (LIME)
lime.desc: The XAI Score (R²) indicates the reliability of the explanation for the chosen row. A score closer to 1.0 means the explanation is highly trustworthy.

params.modelDesc: ML algorithm used to evaluate feature subsets.
